title: Slugs contain repeated and dangling hyphens
body: `make_slug` in `textutil/slug.py` promises that every run of characters other than letters and digits becomes a single hyphen and that a slug never starts or ends with a hyphen. Titles with punctuation break both rules: `make_slug("Hello, World!")` returns `"hello--world-"` instead of `"hello-world"`. Please make the function behave as documented.
